npcs.name: Amaka
npcs.personality: Fashion-obsessed, loyal, loud, dramatic, first to hype you and first to tell you the truth.

greeting: Babe! Where have you been hiding?
See this one, looking like money!
high_score: Ehn ehn! You carry the whole party on your head!
low_score: I love you, but who styled you today?
repeat_colour: Gold again? Chai, you and gold ehn.

npcs.name: Tolu
npcs.personality: Aspiring Afrobeats artist, dreamy, broke but stylish. Becomes a celebrity client if you believe in him early.

greeting: My stylist! When I blow, you're dressing me for the Grammys.

npcs.name: Zara
npcs.personality: Top Lagos influencer. Cares about trends, drama and photo-worthiness. Brutally online.

npcs.name: Chinedu
npcs.personality: Knows everybody, gets you into places, comic relief, always has 'a guy'.

greeting: My person! There's an event tonight, I fit enter you.

npcs.name: Aunty Sade
npcs.personality: Neighbourhood gossip and guardian of tradition. Modesty, respect, and correct cultural dress.

high_score: Ah! This one was raised well. Who is your mother?
low_score: The dress is beautiful. But who told you to combine those shoes?
outshine_bride: Are you the one getting married today? Ehn? Answer me!

npcs.name: Uncle Bayo
npcs.personality: Family friend present at every party. Values decency and dressing right for the occasion. Dry humour, secretly soft.

high_score: Now this is how a responsible person dresses. Well done.
low_score: Is this what they are wearing now? Hmm.

npcs.name: Mrs. Okafor
npcs.personality: Wealthy event organiser. Demanding, generous when impressed, never forgets a disappointment.

npcs.name: Dami
npcs.personality: Rival stylist. Polished, competitive, always finds a flaw. Grudging respect on very high scores; possible friendship arc.

high_score: Fine. It's... fine. Don't let it enter your head.

npcs.name: Iya Bisi
npcs.personality: Balogun fabric queen. Firm but fair, loves good manners, hates time-wasters.

greeting: Fine girl, come and buy! Original fabric, no be copy.
counter: Customer, I go do am for you, but no let me lose money o.
walk_away: Ehen, come back! Oya bring your last price.

npcs.name: Baba Tee
npcs.personality: Cheapest tailor in Yaba. Wildly creative, totally unpredictable, always 'on his way'.

late: I dey come! I'm on my way, just dey your house.
freestyle: I added small style for you. You go like am.

npcs.name: Kunle Cuts
npcs.personality: Expensive, excellent, fast. Measures twice, judges you once.

npcs.name: Hauwa Stitches
npcs.personality: Kano-trained embroidery genius. Affordable and beautiful work, but slow: her waiting list is long.

npcs.name: Mummy
npcs.personality: Your mother. Loving, worried, unimpressed by fashion as a career, secretly proud.

call: You're going out dressed like this?
Fashion will not pay your rent.
proud: My friend showed me your picture. Hmm. It's nice.
